{{Quote|A dee, yes. They’re quite good models, and extremely versatile, though sometimes a little erratic. For any type of sheerly astromechanical or stellar navigation, one cannot better the records of the R2 series in general, and the dee models in particular—or so I’m told.|C-3PO speaking on the model Ds|<ref name="POT">[[Planet of Twilight]]</ref>}}

'''Model Ds''' were a submodel of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. R2 astromechs of this model were considered extremely versatile and particularly adept at astromechanical or stellar navigation. While they boasted a good reputation, they were also considered to be a little erratic. The most notable model D R2-series was [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Behind the scenes==
R2-D2 was first identified as a model D R2-unit in the ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' novel. This indicates that the "D2" suffix of his name corresponds to his submodel, and that all other letters used in the suffixes of other named R2 astromechs potentially indicate other models.
